Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in synthesizing the genealogical information retrieved by WebSurfer. In Step 2, WebSurfer correctly identified that Theudebert I was the son of "Theodoric (Theodoric the Great)" based on the Wikipedia snippet. However, in Step 3, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Wisigard's father-in-law was "Theodoric the Great" and explicitly identified him as "king of the Ostrogoths." This is historically inaccurate in this context; Theodoric the Great was the King of the Ostrogoths, but he was not the father of Theudebert I (King of Austrasia). Theudebert I's father was Theuderic I (also known as Theuderic the Elder), King of Austrasia. The Planner confused the name "Theodoric" (which appears in the search snippet as a variant or error in the source text "Theodoric (Theodoric the Great)") with the actual father, Theuderic I, and incorrectly attributed the title of Ostrogothic King to the Frankish father. This led to the wrong final answer.
